Author: 246tnt
Content: The general idea is you need enough gain so that any voltage difference at the input will result in the output hitting the rails ...

Author: 246tnt
Content: and then ideally some hysteresis so that noise doesn't create a mess if you have slow transitions.

Author: 246tnt
Content: And as you said above, a schmitt trigger is not a bad way to provide both more gain as a second stage and hysteresis.

Author: 246tnt
